goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, save a memo, and navigate the calendar to view the previous month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text area labeled 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
Locate the calendar widget displaying 'June 2026' and click the left-pointing arrow button to navigate to the previous month.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the dashboard displays the current month (June 2026) after account creation.
The memo 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' appears in the feed with a timestamp of 'now'.
The calendar widget updates to display 'May 2026' after clicking the previous month button.
The previously saved memo remains visible in the feed after navigating to the previous month.
